exceptions.expectedSegmentText: What your country can do for you as what you can do for your country. And so my fellow Americans.
exceptions.actualSegmentText: What your country can do for you ask what you can do for your country. And so my fellow Americans.

note: D11.5 widens D11.4 to every platform: the same word flips between 'as' and 'ask' depending on the CPU (Mac M4, hosted Mac ARM/Intel, hosted Ubuntu x86_64), with identical segment input hashes. A run may read either word at this one position; everything else stays exact. Original goldens unchanged; D11.3 timing rules apply.
